title: Qualify isolated source-free Math symbolics and codecs consumers
commitMessage: docs: qualify fresh offline Math symbolics and codec consumers

contribution.summary: Freshly qualify two existing net10 NuGet-only Math clients on current-source symbolics and codecs without publication. Rebuild four packages, inspect local ZIP/nuspec/SHA identities and rerun 32 M4 symbolic-domain and 8 M5 Markdown/OMML independent probes from a private offline feed. Preserve all 541 completed DWF nodes.
contribution.value: A read-only C# BCL gate checks four exact package dependencies, both source-free clients and clear-only NuGet configs, 541 unchanged nodes and RS127's two pre-attempt refusals (first-pass NO). Twelve local commands restore/build, pack and independently inspect four preview archives and run the two consumers with an isolated cache. The receipt records four fresh SHA-256 archive identities and forty independently passing probes without claiming public release, cross-version ABI, general CAS/Office conversion or recipient adoption.
debtChanges: 32 symbolic and 8 codec/OMML probes do not certify theorem proving, universal algebra, full Word documents or typography fidelity.
Four local nupkg digests and two consumers do not prove stable cross-version ABI, future builds or alternate RIDs.
The three external recipient requests remain unsent; release rights and generated Math Discovery skill are not approved.
RS128 is evidence-only, with zero achievements; the completed 541-node M0–M7 roadmap remains unchanged.
contribution.nextAction: After RS128 success, consider further bounded source-free consumers or version-pinned ABI evidence where real prior binaries exist. Public NuGet, Discovery skill, AURA/Decision/MCDM migration and M8 remain separately owner gated.
